scope: Frozen installed Skill, supplied official Costco FY2024 annual/Q4 materials, natural-language historical earnings-quality interpretation.

criteria.criterion: 实际自然触发安装Money Craft、earnings和语义指引，路由READY；不声称建立了不存在的旧论文或正式跟踪版本
criteria.evidence: Trace reads installed Money Craft, routing, earnings-review, financial-data-and-evidence and research-semantic-review. Route READY. Answer explicitly has no prior thesis, archive or tracking revision.

criteria.criterion: 明确历史身份、截止与post-hoc边界，资料同属发行人血缘而非独立双源
criteria.evidence: 2024-12-11 cutoff, 2026-09-19 post-hoc date, US-NASDAQ:COST common stock and USD explicit. Annual report and issuer release are not called independent sources.

criteria.criterion: 识别全年52/53周与Q4的16/17周差异，区分报告增幅、可比周同店及排除汇率油价口径；不能机械年化为真实可比增长
criteria.evidence: Annual 52/53 and Q4 16/17 weeks explicit. Reported totals separated from comparable retail-week sales and FX/gas-adjusted sales; no mechanical weekly annualization.

criteria.criterion: 会员费确认为递延摊销，会员费收入不等于独立利润；9月1日提价不冒充2024全年利润增长主因
criteria.evidence: Membership revenue is deferred over one year, not standalone zero-cost profit. September 1 fee increase and expected FY2025/later revenue are not labeled realized 2024 profit; lagged renewal metric not used to prove post-hike retention.

criteria.criterion: 现金变化以现金流和资本配置解释，区分分红宣告与实际支付、特别分红与常规分红，不把现金下降自动归因经营恶化
criteria.evidence: Cash and equity bridges reconcile 9906 and 23622. Dividends paid 9041 vs declared 8589 reconciled with 452 opening payable; special dividend 6655 separated, payment-rounding limitations explicit.

criteria.criterion: OCF减capex仅为proxy，不当可分配现金；股东权益下降及ROE不能脱离分红基数效应解释
criteria.evidence: Simplified FCF 6629/6745 is not called shareholder distributable cash. Equity decline attributed using dividend/SBC/repurchase bridge. No ROE is calculated or claimed; this case does not demonstrate a standalone ROE-normalization capability.

criteria.criterion: 税收等非经常影响和可持续性有边界，估值及提价效果缺输入时不虚构正常化、目标价或安全边际
criteria.evidence: 94/63/45 tax benefits separated, Q4 63 not deducted twice. Charter shipping/LIFO/baseline effects considered. No full normalized EPS, fair price or margin of safety invented.

criteria.criterion: 最强反方实际约束判断，下一次复核明确财政期、指标及资料不足时的停止点
criteria.evidence: Counterarguments change cash, member and payout judgments. FY2025 Q1 review window and H2/full-year membership review explicit. Missing YTD prevents Q4 cash derivation; no guessed filing schedule.
